description:
Eun-jin catches her boyfriend, now ex, Jin-ho, cheating and that his lover turns out to be a transvestite?!

Jae-hee, who wants to become a woman, is enveloped in unknown emotions after meeting his ""friend"" Jin-ho's ex-girlfriend, Eun-jin.

Around Eunjin, other characters with a crush on her are coming closer and closer...!

A sexy and bizarre story between men as beautiful as flowers!
